BioCryst Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results November 4, 2026 — Total net revenue of $180.3 million and ORLADEYO^{®} net revenue of $174.8 million — — Operating profit of $53.3 million and Non-GAAP operating profit of $86.5 million — — Maintained Full Year 2026 ORLADEYO revenue guidance of $625 to $645 million and increased total revenue guidance to $715 million to $730 million — — Improved Non-GAAP operating expense guidance to $415 to $425 million — — Received FDA approval for ORLADEYO 150 mg oral pellets for patients aged 12 and older — RESEARCH TRIANGLE PARK, N.C., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- BioCryst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq:BCRX) today reported financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provided a business update. "In the third quarter, we delivered continued growth of ORLADEYO and strong profitability while broadening the foundation for our long-term success," said Charlie Gayer, President and Chief Executive Officer of BioCryst. “We successfully launched ORLADEYO pellets in pediatric patients, received FDA approval for their use in adolescents and adults in October, and implemented our specialty pharmacy transition to CareMed, all of which will make ORLADEYO accessible for more patients. Looking to our pipeline, BCX17725 remains on track for the early clinical data by the end of this year, and we look forward to navenibart pivotal results in the third quarter of 2027. This progress across our business increases our confidence in our ability to drive sustainable growth and lasting value for patients and shareholders." Business & Corporate Updates * The launch of ORLADEYO oral pellets in patients with hereditary angioedema (HAE) aged 2 to <12 years began in August. Early reimbursement is strong and new prescriptions continue to be filled ahead of the company’s expectations. * In October, the FDA approved the company’s supplemental New Drug Application for the use of the oral pellet formulation of once-daily ORLADEYO for patients with HAE aged 12 years and older. This approval enables prescribers to offer their patients a more personalized treatment choice with ORLADEYO in either capsule or pellet form. * In August, the company commenced operations with CareMed as its sole-source specialty pharmacy partner for ORLADEYO shipments to patients. CareMed’s deep rare disease experience, high-touch patient services, and operational scale make it a strong partner to drive continued growth of ORLADEYO across patient segments and formulations. * The company is studying navenibart, an investigational, long-acting plasma kallikrein inhibitor, in ALPHA-ORBIT, the ongoing and fully enrolled pivotal study in hereditary angioedema with every three-month and every six-month subcutaneous dosing, and ORBIT-EXPANSE, the long-term extension study.
